audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of rows 0-4 contradicted the explanation printed beside it. win[0]/win[3]/win[4] read "Skill" and win[1]/win[2] read "Yasuo", while whys[0] through whys[4] say Wukong out-damages you at 1, owns level 2, beats your DPS at 3, compounds through 4-5, and can outright kill you at 6.
audit.why: The mirror (wukong__yasuo) set rows 0-4 to Wukong, which matches the packet chart and every prose field on this page. The five phases[].why bodies were also generic Yasuo-favourable boilerplate that described a lane Yasuo controls early — he does not.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group with ratings, and all five stage explanations rewritten to name the mechanic that gives Wukong the row.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why claimed Last Breath "converts ANY knockup into a kill window" at the exact stage Wukong's Cyclone is the kill threat, without stating that Last Breath requires an Airborne target.
audit.why: Riot's text for Last Breath: it blinks to an Airborne enemy champion. Against Cyclone that makes the ultimate a reactive answer, not an opener, and the page had the polarity backwards.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why re-keyed to Cyclone with Last Breath banked as the answer; the first-item and 2-item stages already read correctly and were left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four do/don't bodies were generic boilerplate that had nothing to do with their own titles — "Wait for his W decoy" was answered with a Q-stacking trade line, "Commit into his clone" with a sentence about his favourite window.
audit.why: Warrior Trickster leaving a decoy is the single interaction that punishes a committed Yasuo pattern, and Last Breath's Airborne requirement means a wasted commit costs the whole ultimate.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now states the decoy-and-stealth tell, dosFull[2].d the punish window between Crushing Blow casts, dontsFull[0].d what the decoy actually eats, dontsFull[1].d the Nimbus Strike into empowered Q burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1], spikes[3].text and late describe Wind Wall's effect on Wukong's engage in ways that cannot be checked here.
audit.why: enemyKit is null in this brief, so no Wukong ability text, flags or cooldowns were available. Nothing was asserted about Wind Wall's effect on his dash, and no Wukong cooldown numbers were written anywhere.

edits.before: Stack tornado through the wave; your passive shield eats one poke for free. Identify how Wukong contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Crushing Blow shreds your armour and his passive stacks, so his auto trades beat your crit-less kit — stack tornado through the wave and take none.

edits.before: E dashes through minions make you untouchable in the wave. Only take the trade when Wukong's Nimbus Strike is down.
edits.after: Level 2 is the same Q trade with his passive stacking — dash through minions to farm and give him nothing on the walk-up.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Wukong must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike gives him a dash and attack speed that beat your raw DPS — hold the wave near you and answer only his commit.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Nimbus Strike's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His Q cooldown drops and the trades compound for him — farm safe, bank CS, and keep your passive shield charged for the walk-up.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Wukong's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Cyclone is a point-blank knock-up that can kill you outright — bank Last Breath as the answer to it, never as your opener.

edits.before: Dash through the wave stacking Q, tag Wukong with Q2, and only commit the EQ3 knockup when his answer is down.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster leaves a decoy behind — don't spend Last Breath until the real body shows itself.

edits.before: Wukong wastes Nimbus Strike — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Punish between Crushing Blow casts, with your passive shield charged.

edits.before: That is Wukong's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The decoy eats a full pattern and refunds you nothing — verify first.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike into an empowered Q is his burst — dodge the dash.

notes: enemyKit was null in this brief, so no Wukong cooldowns or ability flags were written anywhere — every number on this page stays Yasuo's own. Rows 0-4 proposed as one atomic paired group.
